channel.desc: Wilderness Way Adventures is a Christ-centered, faith-based nonprofit that blends survival skills with spiritual growth. Hosted by Greg Morikone, this inspiring program features Mike Lowe-veteran survival expert, pastor, and former U.S. Air Force instructor-who has spent over four decades teaching others how to thrive in the wild and in their faith.
